capabilities: keep Obsidian running in the background via a tray icon
toggle window visibility with a global hotkey or tray menu
create quick notes from anywhere with a global hotkey
customize the tray icon image and tooltip
extras: The README includes a disclaimer that the plugin is untested on every platform and may break with future updates, and notes that hiding the taskbar icon may not work on Linux.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run minimized in the system tray or to capture notes and toggle the window from outside the app.
summary: System tray plugin that launches Obsidian at startup, keeps it running in the background, and adds global hotkeys for window toggling and quick notes.
